devdoc.details: This follows the excessively-safe-call pattern: the callee cannot force the caller to copy unbounded return data      and exhaust gas during memory expansion. Admission and settlement are fail-closed and bubble bounded revert data      through typed errors. Cancellation is fail-open for intent-liquidity liveness and emits bounded failure evidence      so the orchestrator can persist a reconciliation record.

executeLifecycleAdmission(IIntentLifecyc.details: A zero hook is an intentional no-op. A non-zero hook must contain deployed code and successfully execute      `onIntentCreated`; otherwise the complete outer intent admission reverts with `LifecycleHookAdmissionFailed`.

params._gasLimit: Exact gas allowance supplied to the callback call.
params._intentHash: Newly created intent identifier readable from the calling orchestrator.
params._lifecycleHook: Snapshotted governance-selected hook, or zero when no risk policy applies.
params._maxReturnDataSize: Maximum revert-data bytes copied from the hook.

executeLifecycleCancellation(IIntentLife.details: A zero hook succeeds without a call. A non-contract hook or reverted callback emits `LifecycleHookCallbackFailed`      and returns false so OrchestratorV3 can store durable recovery state. Before calling, the function verifies      EIP-150 permits the complete configured gas allowance to be forwarded; insufficient outer gas reverts rather      than being misclassified as a hook failure.

params._gasLimit: Exact gas allowance supplied to the callback call.
params._intentHash: Cancelled intent identifier included in the callback and any failure event.
params._lifecycleHook: Snapshotted governance-selected hook, or zero when none applied.
params._maxReturnDataSize: Maximum revert-data bytes copied from the hook.

executeLifecycleSettlement(IIntentLifecy.details: The caller must already validate that `_lifecycleHook` is non-zero deployed code. Any callback failure reverts the      outer settlement with the intent-bound `LifecycleHookSettlementFailed` error and bounded revert data.

params._context: Exact gross amount, executable amount, fee plan, token, recipient, and settlement type.
params._gasLimit: Exact gas allowance supplied to the callback call.
params._lifecycleHook: Snapshotted non-zero lifecycle hook receiving settlement context.
params._maxReturnDataSize: Maximum revert-data bytes copied from the hook.

devdoc.title: BoundedCall

LifecycleHookCallbackFailed(bytes32,addr.notice: Emitted when a fail-open risk cancellation callback does not complete successfully.

executeLifecycleAdmission(IIntentLifecyc.notice: Executes a fail-closed lifecycle admission callback with fixed gas and bounded revert data.

executeLifecycleCancellation(IIntentLife.notice: Executes a fail-open cancellation callback without allowing hook failure to trap intent liquidity.

executeLifecycleSettlement(IIntentLifecy.notice: Executes a fail-closed settlement callback with bounded return data.

userdoc.notice: Executes gas-limited lifecycle-hook callbacks while bounding copied return and revert data.
